## Avoid Bad Results, Explained in this [VIDEO](https://youtu.be/w28RrOnirlM) 

> When using BASE model (change CFGGuider, CFG - make it 5.0 and Flux2Scheduler steps 20) 

> For distill model like flux-2-klein-9b - CFG 1.0 and step 8

Guide: [Subgraph](https://docs.comfy.org/interface/features/subgraph)
